Sam: Quick poll — sunset paddle (6:30) or backyard BBQ (5:00) this Saturday?
Leah: Paddle for me — need my water fix.
Omar: BBQ pls. I can bring skewers and a portable grill.
Ivy: Both sound great. If paddle, can kids come?
Sam: Kids welcome on BBQ but paddle is adult-only (safety).
Leah: Heads up there might be wind at 6:30.
Omar: If windy, BBQ wins.
Ivy: I'm okay with 5:00 BBQ then. I'll bring potato salad.
Sam: Looks like BBQ majority. EventBot: Event created: "Backyard BBQ" Saturday 17:00 - Courtyard.
Leah: I'll bring vegetarian burgers.
Omar: I'll bring charcoal & skewers. See y'all!
_meta: watercooler weekend plans - paddle vs bbq
